title: 2.03 / Spectrum Logo Library
slide_intent: Choose artwork for its background and production conditions so the mark remains recognizable.
strategic_value: A small approved set can preserve Spectrum’s blue identity while accommodating restricted reproduction.
demonstration: A two-by-two comparison shows primary deep-blue and reverse logos above white and black limited-production versions, with file names.
practical_value: Choose primary artwork when possible and use supplied monochrome variants when production is limited.

content_islands.name: Heading and file access
content_islands.spec: Keep the heading left and place the approved-artwork explanation above the variants, with the file access note at left.

content_islands.name: Primary variants
content_islands.spec: Pair the deep-blue logo on white with the reverse logo on blue and retain the associated print and screen file names.

content_islands.name: Limited-production variants
content_islands.spec: Place white-on-black and black-on-white logo specimens in the lower row under the production limitation label.

ingredient.name: Logo color variants
ingredient.role: Maintain identification across backgrounds and production limits.
ingredient.application: Prefer the primary deep-blue or reverse artwork; select black or white only when production is limited.
ingredient.scope: Approved 2017 logo files. Do not redraw the mark.

reference_purposes.Application: The library pairs primary and reverse artwork with print and screen file names, then provides monochrome alternatives for restricted production.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page limits black and white variants to constrained production and prohibits recreating logo artwork.
